title: Predicting Recipe Health
description: This DSC 80 project focuses on predicting how healthy a recipe is using features such as nutrition ratings and health tags associated with each recipe. We are trying to categorize recipes as 'healthy', 'medium-healthy' or 'unhealthy' based on the variables in the recipes and interactions datasets. We will analyze a variety of methods to define 'healthiness' including looking at recipe tags and nutrition information. Our end goal is to create a useful classifier to assign recipes to each of the health ratings.
